scope: Actual worker process, scheduler/lease, encrypted OAuth read, REST evidence, fact/policy/review persistence and idle heartbeat; selected projections, not all worker gates
jobs_sql: SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('status',status,'attempt_count',attempt_count,'max_attempts',max_attempts,'result',result,'last_error_code',last_error_code,'last_error_summary',last_error_summary,'lease_owner_present',lease_owner IS NOT NULL,'lease_expires_present',lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL,'started',started_at IS NOT NULL,'completed',completed_at IS NOT NULL,'retry_delay_matches_37_seconds',CASE WHEN status='retry' THEN abs(extract(epoch FROM available_at-updated_at)-37)<1 ELSE NULL END,'retry_scheduled',CASE WHEN status='retry' THEN available_at>updated_at ELSE NULL END) ORDER BY created_at,id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM issuance_service.canvas_evidence_sync_jobs
facts_sql: SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('fact_type',fact_type,'assertion',assertion,'payload_hash',payload_hash,'verification_method',verification->>'method','effective_at',effective_at) ORDER BY created_at,id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM issuance_service.evidence_facts
oauth_sql: SELECT jsonb_build_object('status',c.status,'reauthorization_required',c.reauthorization_required,'refresh_lease_owner_present',c.refresh_lease_owner IS NOT NULL,'secret_enabled',s.enabled,'secret_used',s.last_used_at IS NOT NULL) FROM issuance_service.canvas_oauth_connections c JOIN issuance_service.organization_integration_secrets s ON s.id='worker-rest-token' WHERE c.id='worker-rest-connection'
